## Docs

* [Phase F00: Project setup](docs/F00-project-setup.md) - Goal: a skeleton that runs, has a test command, and uses the harness as a dependency, not a copy.
* [Phase F01: Driving the harness](docs/F01-driving-the-harness.md) - Goal: run a `noobly` agent from factory code, watch it through events, stop it on demand, and never let it spend more than it's allowed.
* [Phase F02: Isolated workspaces](docs/F02-isolated-workspaces.md) - Goal: give every agent step its own place to work (folder, branch, sandbox settings, harness home) so several can run at once without touching each other, or you.
* [Phase F03: The first job, issue in, PR out](docs/F03-issue-in-pr-out.md) - Goal: the smallest thing that deserves the name "factory".
* [Phase F04: Deterministic gates](docs/F04-deterministic-gates.md) - Goal: stop trusting what the agent says and check what it did.
* [Phase F05: Durable state, the event store](docs/F05-event-store.md) - Goal: make crashes boring.
* [Phase F06: Scheduler, leases and budgets](docs/F06-scheduler-leases-budgets.md) - Goal: go from "one job, when I type a command" to a queue that a long-running `factory serve` drains by itself: several runs at once, in a sensible order, within money limits, with a red button that…
* [Phase F07: The line engine and stations](docs/F07-line-engine.md) - Goal: turn "the job" (one hard-coded function) into an assembly line: stations declared as data, and a pure `decide()` that says what a run should do next.
* [Phase F08: Spec-driven development](docs/F08-spec-driven-development.md) - Goal: for anything bigger than a small change, write down what must be true before anyone writes code: requirements, design and tasks, checked by a program, traced to each other, committed and review…
* [Phase F09: Agent roles](docs/F09-agent-roles.md) - Goal: stop hard-coding "who does what" in JavaScript.
* [Phase F10: Fan-out, fan-in, integration](docs/F10-fan-out-fan-in.md) - Goal: when a spec has several tasks, build them at the same time, each by its own agent in its own workspace, then merge them back into one branch, resolving conflicts, and verify the whole.
* [Phase F11: Reviewer agents](docs/F11-reviewer-agents.md) - Goal: after the facts (gates), judgment: a different role, read-only, reviews the change against the spec and returns structured findings.
* [Phase F12: Humans in the loop](docs/F12-humans-in-the-loop.md) - Goal: put people exactly where they add the most, and nowhere else.
* [Phase F13: Repair loops](docs/F13-repair-loops.md) - Goal: when the checks fail or a review blocks a change, don't just report it: give the exact failure to a fixer, check again, and do that a bounded number of times before asking a person.
* [Phase F14: Scope guard and the evidence bundle](docs/F14-scope-and-evidence.md) - Goal: make review fast.
* [Phase F15: The GitHub forge](docs/F15-github-forge.md) - Goal: the same factory, a real forge.
* [Phase F16: Factory tools for agents (MCP)](docs/F16-factory-tools-mcp.md) - Goal: give agents a narrow, factory-aware API instead of a bigger prompt.
* [Phase F17: The dashboard](docs/F17-dashboard.md) - Goal: a factory you can't see is one you can't trust.
* [Phase F18: Notifications and chatops](docs/F18-notifications-chatops.md) - Goal: bring people in only when they're needed, where they already are: a chat channel, and the issue or PR they're looking at.
* [Phase F19: The factory bench](docs/F19-factory-bench.md) - Goal: unit tests prove code; only end-to-end benchmarks prove a factory.
* [Phase F20: Metrics](docs/F20-metrics.md) - Goal: find out where the line is slow, expensive or untrusted, with numbers computed from the event log.
* [Phase F21: The learning loop](docs/F21-learning-loop.md) - Goal: the factory should make the same mistake at most a few times.
* [Phase F22: Cost-aware routing](docs/F22-cost-aware-routing.md) - Goal: spend strong models where they change the outcome.
* [Phase F23: Containers and remote workers](docs/F23-containers-and-workers.md) - Goal: the same step, far away.
* [Phase F24: Security hardening](docs/F24-security-hardening.md) - Goal: assume every input is hostile and every agent is fallible.
* [Phase F25: Fleet campaigns](docs/F25-fleet-campaigns.md) - Goal: one change, many repositories.
* [Phase F26: Hosted in NooblyJS](docs/F26-hosted-in-NOOBLY.md) - Goal: open the factory's dashboard inside NooblyJS at `/factory`, signed in as yourself, with no server or token of the factory's own.
